effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn. Then, by placing 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait in this Digimon's digivolution cards under 1 of your Tamers, delete 1 of their Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
xros_req: [Digivolve] Play cost 4 or lower [Shoutmon] or [Dorulumon]: Cost 0
